title: Densities and Apparent Molar Volumes of Aqueous Magnesium Sulfate and Sodium Sulfate to 473 K and 100 bar
experimental_method: Dilatometric: the density follows from the change in mercury-column height as the temperature of the solution cell is raised and lowered, calibrated against pure water; pressurised with nitrogen via the mercury; temperature by 25-ohm Pt thermometer.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature stable to +-0.01 K over 30 min; mercury heights to +-0.01 mm; pressure to +-0.1 bar (density uncertainty see paper text, not extracted).
quality_remarks: PDF page 1 is the end of another article (Me2SO/LiCl, pp. 320 references) and was not used; PDF page 1 header page number 320 belongs to the preceding article. Table I right block row 475.32 K, 102.3 bar, m 0.2025: density printed as 0.894.62 (misplaced point), written 0.89462. Table I right block row 294.99 K, 20.3 bar: molality printed as 0.o303 (letter o, typo for 0.3303; neighbouring rows are 0.3303), written 0.3303. Each pressure series cycles the temperature up and then down, so replicate (T, P, m) states appear with slightly different T. Temperature scale not stated. Table IV/V are smoothed fit values.
